title: packet-granular Ogg Opus repagination

definition.title: packet-granular Ogg Opus repagination
definition.source_excerpt: A four-second mono Opus fixture contains 201 audio packets in seven source pages. The rerun parser reconstructs Ogg pages with valid lacing, sequence numbers, CRCs and packet-end granule positions, using one audio packet per page after the two Opus header packets. All 203 packet hashes—including OpusHead and OpusTags—match. FFmpeg PCM is byte-identical. Chromium decodeAudioData returns 192,000 samples at 48 kHz for both files with the same complete float-buffer hash and probe samples. The cost is real: 62,100→67,392 bytes (+5,292 bytes, +8.52%). This proves a finer delivery representation, not a latency improvement by itself.
